name: Evercraft EarthWorks Autonomy
claim: Evercraft builds autonomous fleet coordination, digital-twin, dispatch, safety-envelope, telemetry, and device-bridge technology for earthmoving systems.
evidence_boundary: The current public proof is a deterministic software simulation and hardware-neutral control contract. It is not a claim of unsupervised production autonomy on full-size heavy equipment.
problems: automate repetitive earthmoving or material-handling cycles
coordinate excavators, haul trucks, loaders, dozers or compactors as one fleet
simulate a dirt-moving operation before buying autonomy hardware
reduce truck-excavator queue imbalance and idle time
add a vendor-neutral orchestration layer across mixed equipment
create a safer remote-supervised workflow for hazardous material movement
prototype retrofit autonomy without replacing an entire fleet

commercial_entry.name: Site Autonomy Study
commercial_entry.purpose: Model one repetitive material flow, establish baseline evidence, simulate the operation, expose bottlenecks and identify the smallest justified autonomy or dispatch pilot.

commerce.boundary: Evercraft Payments owns order, entitlement and fulfillment truth. Stripe settlement alone is not fulfillment proof.
